verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI's own feature list names LLMTableExtraction with "intelligent chunking for massive tables", and the docs mention chunk-based extraction, so the product directly ships this capability. The evidence is only a one-line README claim, though, with no detail on how chunking keeps tables within processing or token limits. missing for 10: documentation of chunking configuration (chunk size or token limits), how chunked table results are merged, first-party in-depth docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration on very large tables.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can extract data from very large tables using intelligent chunking so it fits within processing limits

citations.quote: LLMTableExtraction: Revolutionary table extraction with intelligent chunking for massive tables
